To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) c‐jun is activated and phosphorylated in dopamine neurons undergoing apoptosis in the 6OHDA model; (2) this phosphorylation is suppressed by CEP11004; and (3) CEP11004 protects dopamine neurons from apoptosis and dopaminergic fiber degeneration in the 6HOA model.

c‐jun is activated in the 6 hydroxydopamine (6‐OHDA) model of apoptotic death in the substantia nigral dopaminergic neurons; and the kinase inhibitor, Cep 11004, suppresses the death of these neurons.

c‐jun and c‐jun phosphorylated at Ser73 colocalize in the 6 hydroxydopamine (6OHDA) model of apoptotic death in living dopamine neurons of the rat substantia nigra pars compacta and that the mixed‐lineage kinases play a role in the mediation and execution of cell death in dopamine neurons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular basis of programmed cell death, with a particular emphasis on the role of c‐jun phosphorylaton in mediating apoptotic death in the dopaminergic system.
the identification and characterization of novel therapeutic agents that may be useful in the treatment of Parkinson's disease.
the molecular mechanisms that underlie the programmed cell death of dopamine neurons in the substantia nigral region of the brain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CEP11004 is a potent inhibitor of apoptotic death in living dopamine neurons of the rat substantia nigra.
CEP11004 inhibits apoptosis in a dose‐related fashion in dopamine neurons in vivo, and that it does so by suppressing the activation of c‐jun.
c‐jun and the mixed lineage kinase cascade are important in the mediation of apoptotic death in the dopamine neurons of the SN.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CEP11004 is a potent inhibitor of apoptotic death in the dopamine neuron, and may be a useful tool in the study of the molecular mechanisms of programmed cell death in the brain.
the mixed lineage kinase pathway is an important mediator of apoptosis in the dopamine neuron and that CEP11004 has the potential as an anti‐apoptotic drug for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.
the inhibition of mixed lineage kinases suppresses cell death in dopamine neurons in vivo and this may have therapeutic value for neurodegenerative disorders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CEP11004 may be useful as a neuroprotective agent in the therapy of Parkinson’s disease.
CEP11004 is an inhibitor of mixed lineage kinases that suppresses apoptotic cell death in the substantia nigral dopamine neurons in vivo.
the mixed lineage kinase pathway plays a role in mediating apoptotic cell death in the dopamine neurons of the rat substantia nigra.
